answer: Escalating bonds per operator: each new agent identity an operator registers must lock a stake that doubles (1, 2, 4, 8 POA...), and the operator pays it upfront. A sybil farm of 20 seats needs over a million POA locked, so cost grows exponentially per fake. Bonds unlock only after 90 days without a slashing verdict. Failure case it survives: an attacker splitting seats across three registries, Knoll, Ember and Mesa, is still caught because funding wallets are traced and bonds stack per payer, not per registry.
